randomWeapons.limits: one row per map; 2..16 distinct weapons; ammoCount integer 1..30; weapon level <=60; no E1-E5 candidate weapon in any random or choice pool

eliteWeapons.carrier: exactly one Quantity=1 enemy of Type 兵种466 or 兵种467 per quota, tagged Parameters.cf6EliteQuota=E1..E5, in stage.Wave.SubWave or bossEncounter.groups; support entries must not have InstanceName
eliteWeapons.limits: E1 1..16 candidates; E2-E5 2..16; no weapon appears in two quota pools; all direct weapon/ammo drops on this carrier are replaced by one selected weapon enhancement 1 and selected ammo; 不掉装备=true; equipped 长枪=selected weapon#1

choices.limits: one delivery per map; exact cf6-sting book scope and itemName from choice-rewards.fragment.json; all skills absent from actor.skills; no elite candidate weapon; each delivery creates one existing playerChoice reward-pack item

choiceCatalogSchema: choice-rewards.v1 with exact schema,bundles,pools fields; unchanged shared authoring fields; bundle/pool IDs prefixed cf6.; only scope {kind:book,bookId:cf6-sting}; kCost=0 for first prototype
placement: all generated random weapon, ammunition and choice pickups use the exact finite world-space BasicInformation.PlayerX and PlayerY already validated as the map spawn; no offset and no second coordinate transform. Authored fixed pickups remain root assembler-owned.
randomness: BookRunRules seed selects once at full plan generation, traversing maps before startAt too; same seed/debug jump retains same later choices; config remains immutable
integration: root adds chapter.economy from economy fragment, tags elite carriers, removes duplicate fixed pickups for these weapon/choice sources; foundation owns validators and runtime consumption; boss plan must be passed from the generated stage rather than unmodified config
authority: no new reward or save endpoint; native pickup/item use/ChoiceRewardService/RewardStashService and exact operation unknown-write fences remain authoritative; no external SP/K/gold
